P13/O7 executes #html.frame([#html.elem("div")[x]]) through the public HTML pipeline and requires Err with a non-empty diagnostic. The candidate scans the complete frame body and returns the explicit diagnostic html.frame body contains content unsupported by paged layout before intrinsic layout or SVG serialization; the sealed test passes in all three orders. Successful empty SVG, omission, bare-text fallback, and literal-frame fallback are therefore rejected.
O7 calls export_html directly on unresolved Content::HtmlFrame and observes an explicit resolver/frame error.
